name: Coherence
description: Measures how logically consistent and understandable the response is within the context of the conversation.

name: Relevance
description: Assesses the degree to which the response pertains to the topic and context of the preceding dialogue and the interesting fact provided.

name: Creativity
description: Evaluates the originality and inventiveness of the response, considering how unique or surprising it is compared to typical conversational continuations.

name: Engagement Level
description: Determines how well the response encourages further dialogue and interaction, fostering a sense of connection or interest.

name: Clarity
description: Measures how clearly the ideas are expressed in the response, including grammar, vocabulary, and overall comprehensibility.
